from typing import assert_type
from phoenix_channels_python_client import (
    Channel, Client, Message, ProtocolVersion,
)
client = Client('ws://localhost/socket', api_key=None, protocol_version=ProtocolVersion.V2)
assert_type(client, Client)
room = client.channel('room:1', params=lambda: {'token': 'fresh'})
assert_type(room, Channel)
@room.on('event')
async def on_event(payload: dict[str, object]) -> None:
    pass
async def scoped() -> None:
    async with room:
        pass
assert_type(client.channel_socket_url, str)
assert_type(ProtocolVersion.V2.vsn, str)
def receive(message: Message) -> str:
    return message.topic
async def stop() -> None:
    await client.shutdown()
